# Comfy Image Upscale- Topaz Bloom 2

Enhance AI-generated images with Bloom 2, a creative upscaling model that adds new detail, texture, and visual elements while offering a Creativity control from 1–9 for subtle refinement or bold reinterpretation. It accepts 1 input image and produces 1 enhanced output, with optional Face Recovery, Color Preservation, and grain settings for fine-tuned results. Ideal for improving AI artwork and illustrations, adding realism to CG renders, and refining facial detail in generated portraits. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_topaz_image_enhance_bloom2.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
